description: Turn total study hours and days left into a realistic day-by-day study plan that respects your daily limit.

faqs.a: It spreads hours evenly across the days. If the even split exceeds your daily limit, it fills each day to the limit and tells you exactly how many hours won't fit.
The plan covers the days before the exam — day 1 is today and the last day is the day before the exam.
faqs.q: Does the plan include the exam day itself?

faqs.a: Yes — the table adjusts automatically; if the load no longer fits your daily limit you'll see a warning.
faqs.q: What if I change my daily availability?

howto: Enter total study hours needed and days until the exam.
Set the maximum hours you can study per day.
Press Build plan for a day-by-day table.
Follow the plan — adjust inputs anytime to rebuild.
title: Study Session Planner
